meta.description: FrontierBoard issue tracker — bugs, features, and deferred work

workflow.note: PROJ is the dev clone (make changes, push here). BOARD is the review board (has .board/, reviews PROJ). Both are clones of stefans71/FrontierBoard at commit e8c62b2.

tasks.title: Container fails when project has no .env file
tasks.description: docker run with -v /dev/null:/workspace/project/.env:ro fails when the project directory has no .env file. Docker cannot create a mountpoint inside a read-only filesystem mount. Workaround applied: touch $PROJ/.env before launch. Fix needed: /run skill must check for .env existence and skip the mount or create placeholder. Setup templates must document this.

tasks.title: Codex .codex/ directory not chowned for container uid
tasks.description: Setup chowns outbox/ and learnings/ to uid 1000 for container agents but misses .codex/ (and .claude/). Codex needs write access to .codex/ for session state. Fix: the chown step in setup must include all CLI settings directories: .codex/, .claude/, .qwen/. Workaround applied: chown -R 1000:1000 on .codex/ manually.

tasks.title: Token exposure via docker inspect / env vars
tasks.description: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN passed as env var is visible via docker inspect on the host. Any process with Docker access can read it. Consider mounting a temp file instead and reading inside the container.

tasks.title: No TTL cache on per-request credential file reads
tasks.description: The credential proxy reads credential files from disk on every request. Under load this is unnecessary I/O. Add a short TTL cache (e.g. 30s) for credential reads.

tasks.title: Upstream detection heuristics fragile
tasks.description: Proxy routes requests based on user-agent and URL heuristics. These are brittle — CLI updates may change user-agent strings or URL patterns without warning.

tasks.title: Proxy rate limiting and authentication
tasks.description: The credential proxy has no rate limiting or authentication. Any process that can reach the Docker bridge IP can use it to make API calls with the host's credentials.

tasks.title: Proxy implementation is FB-only (decoupled from external projects)
tasks.description: FrontierBoard's credential proxy is its own standalone implementation. No convergence with external projects needed — FB is an independent project. Closed: NanoClaw decoupling completed 2026-03-20.

tasks.title: No automated tests for credential proxy
tasks.description: The credential proxy has zero test coverage. Given it handles authentication for all container agents, it needs at least integration tests covering: OAuth routing, API key injection, expired token rejection, path normalization.

tasks.title: Document .codex/ writable mount threat model
tasks.description: The .codex/ directory is mounted read-write into containers so Codex can write session state. This means a compromised Codex agent could modify its own config. The threat model should be documented.

tasks.title: REVIEW-SOP.md does not require re-running failed agents
tasks.description: When an agent fails to produce a report, the SOP allows the review to continue with fewer perspectives. With only 3 agents (minimum for tiebreaker), losing 1 means insufficient perspective diversity. The SOP should require re-running failed agents before proceeding.
